description: A critical security incident has been detected in your organization and you must immediately deploy an emergency coordination meeting. Using Jitsi Meet at http://localhost:8080, set up a secure emergency response meeting with all of the following: (1) Create a meeting room named 'Incident-Response-CRIT001'. (2) Enable the Lobby feature so only approved responders can enter the meeting. (3) Set a meeting password to prevent unauthorized access. (4) Enable the policy that all participants start with their microphone muted. (5) Use the in-meeting chat to send the following exact message to notify responders who are already in the room: 'INCIDENT RESPONSE ACTIVE - All responders acknowledge attendance'. (6) Copy the meeting invitation link to the clipboard for distribution to the response team. (7) Document the entire incident response meeting setup in a report at /home/ga/Desktop/incident_response_meeting_report.txt. The report must include: the full meeting URL, all security controls you activated, the chat message you sent, and access instructions for responders. This is a time-sensitive operational task.

metadata.chat_message: INCIDENT RESPONSE ACTIVE - All responders acknowledge attendance
